proof:
Source. Simon Appendix B, Lemma B.11 and its printed proof (chapter-B.txt lines 160–215), as in step 2 of the parent proof. The finite-dimensional algebra is kernel-checked in SimonGMT (Poincare.SimonGMT.AppendixB, files LagrangeIdentity.lean and ConeDefect.lean: simonsDefect_eq_sum_skew, four_mul_radialSkewSum_le, radial_derivative_of_codazzi, cone_simonsDefect_lower_bound). That module is not imported by the frozen Submission. A formalization may add the import, or reprove the algebra given in step 7. The printed proof uses a frame that is constant along the ray ℓ_x. Here the radial derivative is computed frame-free from the homogeneity C(tx) = t⁻¹C(x), which gives the printed identity (2) h_{ij;n} = −r⁻¹h_ij directly.

Notation. Fix x ∈ M with |A|²(x) > 0 and put ρ := |x| > 0 (0 ∉ M). T := tangentSpace M x; P_y := orthogonal projection onto span tangentSpace M y; e_1, …, e_P the standard basis. C(y) := Dν(y)∘P_y and D_aC := fderivWithin ℝ C M x a. Then |A|²(x) = Σ_i |Dν(x)(P_xe_i)|², |∇A|²(x) := Σ_{i,j,k}((D_{P_xe_k}C)(P_xe_i)·P_xe_j)², and |∇|A|²|²(x) := Σ_k(fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x (P_xe_k))², where |A|² denotes the function y ↦ Σ_i|Dν(y)(P_ye_i)|². The claim is 2(|A|²)²/ρ² + |∇|A|²|²/4 ≤ |A|²·|∇A|² at x.

1. (Facts from the siblings.) normal_complement: T = A₀ ∩ ν(x)^⊥ is a linear subspace of dimension m (dim A₀ = m + 1, ν(x) ≠ 0). For y ∈ M, P_y = P̃(y) with P̃(y)w := Πw − (ν(y)·w)ν(y). So C = C̃ on M with C̃(y) := Dν(y)∘P̃(y), which is C^∞ on an open O ⊇ M where ν is C^∞. By tangent_fderiv, D_aC = DC̃(x)a and fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x a = DÃ(x)a for a ∈ T, where Ã(y) := Σ_i|C̃(y)e_i|². cone_normal: x ∈ T; Dν(x)x = 0; for t > 0, tangentSpace M (tx) = T and t·Dν(tx)v = Dν(x)v (v ∈ T). codazzi: for a, b, d ∈ T, Dν(x)a ∈ T, Dν(x)a·b = Dν(x)b·a, and (D_aC)(b)·d is symmetric in (a, b) and in (b, d).

2. (Radial frame.) x̂ := x/ρ ∈ T is a unit vector, so m ≥ 1; put n := m − 1. Extend x̂ to an orthonormal basis τ_0, …, τ_n of T with τ_n = x̂ (Orthonormal.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension). Indices below run over Fin (n + 1) = Fin m, and the last index n is radial.

3. (Components.) h_ab := −Dν(x)τ_a·τ_b = −C(x)τ_a·τ_b (P_xτ_a = τ_a), and dh_abc := −(D_{τ_c}C)(τ_a)·τ_b.

4. (Hypotheses of the cone algebra.)
 (h_flip) h_ab = h_ba, by codazzi.
 (h_last) h_{n b} = −Dν(x)x̂·τ_b = −ρ⁻¹Dν(x)x·τ_b = 0, and h_{a n} = h_{n a} = 0. These are the printed (1), h_nj = h_jn = 0 on ℓ_x.
 (dh_flip) dh_abc = dh_bac, by codazzi: symmetry in the two slots.
 (codazzi) dh_abc = dh_acb. By codazzi, (D_{τ_c}C)(τ_a)·τ_b = (D_{τ_a}C)(τ_c)·τ_b = (D_{τ_a}C)(τ_b)·τ_c = (D_{τ_b}C)(τ_a)·τ_c.
 (radial homogeneity) dh_{a b n} = −ρ⁻¹h_ab; this is the printed (2), h_{ij;n} = −r⁻¹h_ij. Proof: for t > 0, P_{tx} = P_x since tangentSpace M (tx) = T. For every w, P_xw ∈ T, so Dν(tx)(P_xw) = t⁻¹Dν(x)(P_xw). Hence C(tx) = t⁻¹C(x). The curve γ(s) := (1 + s)x, s ∈ (−1,1), lies in M (cone property), with γ(0) = x and γ'(0) = x ∈ T. C̃ is differentiable at x and C̃∘γ = C∘γ, so by the chain rule and step 1, (d/ds)C(γ(s))|_{s=0} = DC̃(x)x = D_xC. But C(γ(s)) = (1 + s)⁻¹C(x), whose derivative at 0 is −C(x). So D_xC = −C(x), D_{x̂}C = −ρ⁻¹C(x), and dh_{abn} = −(D_{τ_n}C)(τ_a)·τ_b = ρ⁻¹C(x)τ_a·τ_b = −ρ⁻¹h_ab.
 (dh_radial) dh_{r n k} = dh_{r k n} = −ρ⁻¹h_{rk}, by (codazzi) and (radial homogeneity). This is SimonGMT radial_derivative_of_codazzi.

5. (Translation of the three quantities.)
 (a) |A|²(x) = Σ_{a,b}h_ab². By the Hilbert–Schmidt identity (for a linear map L, Σ_j|L(P_xe_j)|² = Σ_a|Lτ_a|², because P_xe_j = Σ_a(e_j·τ_a)τ_a and Σ_j(e_j·τ_a)(e_j·τ_b) = δ_ab), Σ_j|Dν(x)(P_xe_j)|² = Σ_a|Dν(x)τ_a|² = Σ_{a,b}(Dν(x)τ_a·τ_b)². The last step uses Parseval in T, since Dν(x)τ_a ∈ T. This is secondFundamentalNormSq h.
 (b) |∇A|²(x) = Σ_{a,b,c}dh_abc² = derivativeNormSq dh. Apply the same identity Σ_jℓ(P_xe_j)² = Σ_aℓ(τ_a)² for linear functionals ℓ in each slot of the trilinear form (u, v, w) ↦ (D_{P_xu}C)(P_xv)·P_xw.
 (c) |∇|A|²|²(x) = 4Σ_c(Σ_{a,b}h_ab dh_abc)². For τ ∈ T: fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x τ = DÃ(x)τ = 2Σ_j C(x)e_j·(D_τC)e_j (product rule; step 1). Write e_j = P_xe_j + (e_j − P_xe_j). Since e_j − P_xe_j ⊥ T, (D_τC)(e_j − P_xe_j)·C(x)e_j is the pairing of a vector with C(x)e_j = C(x)P_xe_j. Summing over j, Σ_j C(x)P_xe_j·(D_τC)(e_j − P_xe_j) is the trace of the bilinear form (u, w) ↦ C(x)P_xu·(D_τC)(w − P_xw). This trace vanishes, because the form is zero for u ⊥ T and for w ∈ T, so its trace over an orthonormal basis adapted to T ⊕ T^⊥ is 0. Hence fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x τ = 2Σ_jC(x)P_xe_j·(D_τC)P_xe_j = 2Σ_aC(x)τ_a·(D_τC)τ_a (trace of a bilinear form on T). Expanding C(x)τ_a ∈ T in the basis gives 2Σ_{a,b}(C(x)τ_a·τ_b)((D_τC)τ_a·τ_b). With τ = τ_c this is 2Σ_{a,b}h_ab dh_abc = 2·contraction h dh c. Finally Σ_k(fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x (P_xe_k))² = Σ_c(fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x τ_c)² by the Hilbert–Schmidt identity for the linear functional fderivWithin ℝ |A|² M x.

6. (Lower bound.) This step uses SimonGMT, so the formalization must add `import Poincare.SimonGMT.AppendixB.ConeDefect` (the module is built in the pinned package; Submission.lean imports may be extended), or else reprove the algebra as in step 7. By SimonGMT cone_simonsDefect_lower_bound (with n = m − 1, the arrays h and dh of step 3, ρ, and the hypotheses h_last_left, h_last_right, h_flip, dh_flip, dh_radial of step 4, and hA : 0 < secondFundamentalNormSq h = |A|²(x)):
 2ρ⁻²|A|²(x) ≤ simonsDefect h dh = Σ dh² − Σ_c(contraction h dh c)²/|A|² = |∇A|²(x) − |∇|A|²|²(x)/(4|A|²(x)).
Multiplying by |A|²(x) > 0 gives 2(|A|²(x))²/ρ² + |∇|A|²|²(x)/4 ≤ |A|²(x)·|∇A|²(x). This is the claim.

7. (The algebra of step 6, as printed.) Write |A|² := Σh_ab², D := Σ dh_abc² − |A|⁻²Σ_c(Σ_{a,b}h_ab dh_abc)². Lagrange's identity gives D = ½|A|⁻²Σ_cΣ_{a,b,r,s}(h_rs dh_abc − h_ab dh_rsc)² (expand the square; SimonGMT simonsDefect_eq_sum_skew). Keep only the index quadruples in which exactly one of the four indices a, b, r, s equals n and it sits in the pair (r, s) or in the pair (a, b). There are four disjoint placements: (r, s) = (r, n) or (n, r), or (a, b) = (a, n) or (n, a), with the other three indices < n. By h_flip, dh_flip and h_last each placement contributes Σ_{a,b,r<n}(h_ab dh_{rnc})², so Σ_{a,b,r,s} ≥ 4Σ_{a,b,r<n}(h_ab dh_{rnc})² (SimonGMT four_mul_radialSkewSum_le). Hence D ≥ 2|A|⁻²Σ_cΣ_{a,b,r<n}(h_ab dh_{rnc})². By dh_radial, dh_{rnc} = −ρ⁻¹h_{rc}, so D ≥ 2ρ⁻²|A|⁻²(Σ_{a,b<n}h_ab²)(Σ_{r<n, c}h_rc²) = 2ρ⁻²|A|⁻²|A|²|A|² = 2ρ⁻²|A|², using h_last for the two sums (SimonGMT radialSkewSum_eq and secondFundamentalNormSq_eq_tangential). ∎
key_steps: Orthonormal basis τ_0..τ_n of T_x (n = m−1) with τ_n = x/|x|; h_ab := −Dν(x)τ_a·τ_b, dh_abc := −(D_{τ_c}C)(τ_a)·τ_b.
Dν(x)x = 0 gives h_{n·} = h_{·n} = 0; codazzi gives symmetry of h and total symmetry of dh.
C(tx) = t⁻¹C(x) along the ray (cone_normal), so D_xC = −C(x) and dh_{abn} = −|x|⁻¹h_ab; with Codazzi dh_{rnk} = −|x|⁻¹h_rk.
Printed B.11 algebra (SimonGMT cone_simonsDefect_lower_bound): 2|x|⁻²|A|² ≤ |∇A|² − |∇|A|²|²/(4|A|²); multiply by |A|².
